verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an identity/auth infrastructure platform, not an AI agent or agent framework — it has no functionality where a user 'plugs in' MCP servers so *it* can consume their tools. Its only MCP-related feature is the reverse: exposing its own MCP server so external AI agents can call the WorkOS API (workos-docs-8/9/15/44), which is a different axis (serving, not consuming, MCP tools).
